title: tabebuia elliptica
intro: Tabebuia elliptica, commonly known as Lapacho or Tabebuia, is a deciduous tree native to South America, particularly in the tropical regions of Argentina, Brazil, and Paraguay. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Tabebuia elliptica include its immunomodulatory and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system. Its bioactive constituents, such as lapachol, naphthoquinones, and flavonoids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties.
